Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting certain higher education employees to engage in collective bargaining.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permitting certain higher education employees toengage in collective bargaining; and adding a new section to chapter41.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to the entities listed in RCW 41.56.020, this chapterapplies to fulltime and parttime University of Washington extensionlecturers in English language programs holding annual and quarterlycontracts.
